BAGONG PIUP'NAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph OILG OPINION NO S. 2015_ JAN 3 0 2025 MR. VICENTE SALANAP Dear Mr. Salanap: This has reference to your query lodged through the Electronic Freedom of Information (eFOI), requesting this Departmenfs legal opinion on the application of Section 270 of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) on delinquent taxes since 2000. Section 270 provides for the prescriptive periods in collecting real property taxes, viz: Section 270. Period Within Which to Collect Real Property Taxes. The basic real property tax and other tax levied under this Title shall be collected within five (5) years from the date they become due. No action for the collection of the tax, whether administrative or judicial, shall be instituted after the expiration of such period. In case of fraud or intent to evade payment of the tax, such action may be instituted for the collection of the same within ten (IO) years from the discovery of such fraud or intent to evade payment. The period of prescription within which to collect shall be suspended for the time during which: I. The local treasurer is legally prevented from collecting the tax; 2. The owner of the property or the person having legal interest therein requests for reinvestigation and executes a waiver in writing before the expiration of the period within which to collect; and 3. The owner of the property of the person having legal interest therein is out of the country or otherwise cannot be located. Applying the foregoing to your query, We opine that in the absence of fraud, intent to evade, and the three (3) circumstances enumerated above, payment, taxes due from 2000 until 2021 can no longer be collected due to the 5-year prescriptive period. Thus, only taxes from 2021 to 2025 can be collected. However, should any of the three circumstances enumerated above be present, the five-year period to collect shall be suspended until the three circumstances cease to exist. In other words, the period during which any of the three circumstances have existed shall not be counted in determining the five-year prescriptive period. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

Lastly, should there be fraud or intent to evade payment, taxes due from 2000 until present are legally demandable and the local treasurer's office shall have IO years from date of discovery within which to institute collection proceedings. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: ATTY. ROMEO P. BENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNRPB/LLLS/LRALLD/agbl MIA BELLA V. NANON SAO.
